reason: The gas cylinders can collect carbon dioxide at the processor's outlet.
expectation: The outlet will fill a cylinder with captured carbon dioxide.

effect: The cylinder collected carbon dioxide upstream of the oxygen-making cell, completing the chapter while leaving the breathing-oxygen line running.
reaction: The connection between the existing processor and a methane ingredient was satisfying, though the chapter ended just as the fuel-making setup became interesting.

mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting carbon dioxide was worthwhile because it connected an existing life-support machine to the return-fuel plan and explained where the carbon comes from.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter was too brief to explore the fuel-making process beyond collecting one ingredient.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the carbon dioxide to be drawn off before the oxygen-making cell while the breathing line continued running.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary; the cylinder and named outlet made the only action's purpose clear.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the collected carbon dioxide and hydrogen become return fuel, especially if the process receives a similarly practical explanation.
